projects.name: INTI-MBA Chatbot — RAG Study Assistant with Self Auto-Ingestion
projects.tech: Python, FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph, Pinecone, RapidOCR, PyMuPDF, APScheduler, MCP, Next.js
projects.description: LangGraph agent over four live Canvas LMS courses: multi-query retrieval, LLM document grading and query-rewriting self-correction, returning answers cited to source file and page. A daily APScheduler job diffs Canvas against a local manifest and re-embeds only what changed, with report-only deletion so a partial API response can never wipe real sources. RapidOCR plus PyMuPDF recover text from scanned pages and images embedded in DOCX/PPTX. A supervisor agent routes intent across research, summary and direct-answer specialists, and an MCP server exposes the study tools to external agents.

projects.name: Cross-Agent Context Engineering — Persistent Second Brain
projects.tech: Rust, SQLite FTS5, hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vector + graph RRF), all-MiniLM-L6-v2, MCP, Codegraph, Next.js
projects.description: Persistent memory layer shared by Claude Code and Codex through native lifecycle hooks, fusing BM25, vector search and graph RRF. Reached 96.0% Recall@5 and 0.922 MRR across 246,750 turns with session-start context capped at 1,500 tokens. Built after discovering hooks were failing silently: instrumented every context touchpoint, defined benchmarks across time windows, and shipped a console tracking hook delivery, retrieval quality, token baselines and deployment drift.

projects.name: Multi-Agent Autopilot — Self-Driving Phase Pipeline
projects.tech: JavaScript, Agent Skills, MCP, Playwright, prompt engineering
projects.description: Scaffolding and CLI pipeline (kickstart, autopilot, UAT-runbook) that chains a top-tier planning model to a cheaper executor model, cutting manual prompting to zero with crash-safe resumption across sessions. An automated evaluation loop feeds Playwright screenshot evidence back to the planning model for code review at each delivery phase.

projects.name: BersamaAi — Autonomous Trending News AI Agent
projects.tech: Python, GCP Compute Engine, GitHub Actions, Discord MCP, GLM-5.2, Groq Whisper ASR
projects.description: Ingestion workflow routing every candidate item through an LLM-as-a-Judge that grades relevance and classifies it into one of nine topic channels, publishing every three hours via GitHub Actions. Ships an MCP server exposing Discord as a tool surface to AI agents, and an ASR path that recovers caption-less video on a daily cron. Running in production on a GCP VM.
